# DramTrack contributor instructions

DramTrack is a static GitHub Pages app. Edit index.html, styles.css, logic.js and web.js. Keep ranking and recommendation behavior consistent with SPEC.md. Preserve saved browser data and personal CSVs.

Use a single integer APP_VERSION and matching asset query versions. Update SPEC.md for changes. Run focused logic checks, JavaScript syntax checks and git diff --check. Push authorized releases to main; GitHub Actions publishes the public asset allowlist to Pages.

Never commit credentials or personal data. No backend or package installation is required. Keep releases concise.
